about_snippet.title: Integrated Corporate Solutions
about_snippet.text: Since our inception in 2016, OSAN GROUP has steadily transformed into a forward-looking conglomerate in the Sultanate of Oman. By building specialized subsidiaries and cultivating strategic public and private alliances, we provide comprehensive, one-stop business and lifestyle infrastructure for individuals, SMEs, and institutional investors alike.

ceo_message.title: Founder & CEO Message
ceo_message.author: Abdullah Al Hasani
ceo_message.body: Since our founding in 2016, OSAN GROUP has moved forward guided by an unwavering vision and high ambitions. Year after year, we have expanded strategically by launching focused enterprises and forging impactful local and international alliances that deliver end-to-end solutions for entrepreneurs, corporates, and cross-border investors. Today, we take immense pride in our active footprint across key commercial industries, reinforcing Oman's economic fabric and aligning our trajectory with the ambitious targets of Oman Vision 2040. Everything we have built reflects the sustained trust of our clients, the dedication of our national workforce, and the strength of our partners. We remain committed to continuous innovation and institutional excellence to unlock lasting value for our stakeholders and our nation.

vision.desc: To be the premier and trusted partner in integrated business and investment solutions across the Sultanate of Oman, advancing institutional excellence, sustainable development, and the goals of Oman Vision 2040.

osbic.name: OSBIC International
osbic.tagline: Your Premier Corporate Gateway to GCC Business Expansion
osbic.desc: Established in 2011, OSBIC International is a recognized leader in enterprise formation, foreign investment advisory, and corporate government liaison services across the GCC. Backed by more than 15 years of institutional experience, OSBIC has empowered more than 3,000 corporate entities, foreign investors, and entrepreneurs.

maisarah.name: Maisarah Auditing & Financial Consultant
maisarah.tagline: Financial Precision, Regulatory Clarity, and Sustainable Growth
maisarah.desc: Maisarah operates as a specialized advisory firm staffed by senior chartered accountants and financial analysts. The firm provides enterprises with analytical depth, rigorous compliance frameworks, and proactive fiscal strategies tailored to Oman's regulatory landscape.

service_centers.tagline: Muscat’s Leading Executive & Regulatory Facilitation Hubs

asas.name: Asas Services Center
asas.desc: An advisory knowledge center providing proactive administrative counsel, investor support, and continuous tracking of major economic developments such as IPOs and regulatory shifts.

masar.name: Masar Services Center
masar.desc: A dedicated tax and regulatory compliance center helping businesses organize filings, adhere to Omani laws, and avoid statutory penalties.

amer.name: Amer Service Center
amer.desc: Positioned in Muscat's central commercial corridor, Amer specializes in rapid company setup, regulatory follow-ups, and corporate PRO documentation.

tamkeen.name: Tamkeen Services Center
tamkeen.desc: A comprehensive hub for citizens and resident entrepreneurs to manage commercial registrations, municipal licenses, and Ministry of Labour/manpower affairs.

nameer.name: Nameer Properties
nameer.tagline: Full-Spectrum Real Estate Management, Brokerage & Investment
nameer.desc: Headquartered in Muscat, Nameer Properties delivers end-to-end real estate brokerage, property management, and asset development services for residential, commercial, and industrial portfolios.

misk.name: Misk Business Center
misk.tagline: Modern, Flexible & Connected Workspaces in the Heart of Muscat
misk.desc: Situated in Ghala's prime commercial district, Misk Business Center is an integrated coworking, private serviced office, and business support facility crafted for growing teams, modern consultants, and startups.
